basic_info.description: This is it, YOUR NEW HOME! Welcome to this beautifully updated home in the highly desirable Portola neighborhood of San Francisco. Boasting numerous upgrades throughout, this exceptional property features a bright and open floor plan, brand new exterior and interior designer paint, new roof with permit, all new recessed lighting and light fixtures throughout, gorgeous vinyl plank flooring, all brand new windows, stylishly remodeled bathrooms, and a stunning kitchen with new quartz countertops, modern cabinets, and brand new appliances. Enjoy spending time also in the easily maintained backyard with brand new fence, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. Conveniently located, this house is within close distance to numerous shops, restaurants, and parks. Whatever your lifestyle, Portola's ideal location and distinctive community lets you create a life uniquely you, and this exceptional modern home will have you and your family living the good life for years to come. WELCOME TO YOUR NEW HOME!
